Q1_test_calibration_issue.calibration_evidence: v1.85/v1.89: asymptotic h=12 Portmanteau over-rejects (~21%) with month dummies at the correct lag; bootstrap is conservative in the intermediate lag-2 region

Q2_genuine_misspecification.rule: misspecification-consistent label AND probe A or B reduces Q*_12 by >= 30%

candidates: none identified by the preregistered rule

post_hoc_interpretation_notes.status: post-hoc; added after the preregistered labels were computed; labels unchanged
post_hoc_interpretation_notes.white_noise_baselines: under residual white noise every one of the K^2 = 9 whitened cells has equal expectation, so the expected cross-equation share of Q*_12 is 6/9 = 0.67, the own-equation share 1/3, the lags 1-3 share 3/12 = 0.25, the lag-12 share 1/12 = 0.083 and the lags 11-13 share 0.25. The preregistered cross_equation_lag_dependence rule (cross share >= 0.50) therefore does not indicate excess cross dependence: observed cross shares (0.49-0.59) are at or below the white-noise baseline, and no cross-lag pair has a BH q-value below 0.05.
post_hoc_interpretation_notes.observed_pattern: Q*_12 is spread across lags (top-3-lag share 0.37-0.52); no equation Ljung-Box(12) or ARCH-LM(12) BH q-value is below 0.05; HICP shows own lag-12 autocorrelation of about 0.21-0.25 in Poland, Romania and Czechia (above the +-0.17 band), including the v2 Czechia model with month dummies (seasonal dynamic rather than seasonal mean dependence); the v1 models retain HICP month-of-year mean effects (equal-means F p < 0.01) because they have no seasonal controls; the 2020-2021 window (18% of observations) carries 33-39% of the Mahalanobis residual mass and 41-49% of the lag-product mass, with IPI residuals of about -7 to -8 standard deviations in 2020-04; residual covariance log determinants differ by about 2-4 between the pre-2020 and 2020-2021 periods.
post_hoc_interpretation_notes.reading: The remaining dependence is weak and diffuse rather than concentrated in a specific lag structure; the probes (extra lag, lag-12 block, pre-2020 sample) reduce Q*_12 by at most 19% and never by the preregistered 30%. The pattern is consistent with a mix of test-calibration issues (v1.85/v1.89), pandemic-period variance instability and outliers, and modest HICP seasonal dynamics; it does not show a clear misspecification that one additional lag or a lag-12 block would fix. Probe C for v2 models has observations per parameter 3.2 (below the production gate of 4) and is diagnostic only.
